verified_facts.text: The hotel is located opposite the Opera Garnier.
verified_facts.excerpt: ideally located opposite the Opera Garnier

verified_facts.text: The hotel was inaugurated under Napoleon III.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inaugurated under Napoleon III, the InterContinental Paris le Grand is a landmark of Parisian luxury

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are decorated in a Second Empire style infused with contemporary touches.
verified_facts.excerpt: decorated in a Second Empire style infused with contemporary touches

verified_facts.text: The hotel's reception venues include the listed Opera ballroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: unique reception venues such as the listed Opera ballroom

verified_facts.text: The grand ballroom, now called the Salon Opera, has a 14-meter-high dome with gilding, arcades, caryatids and candelabras.
verified_facts.excerpt: With its 14-meter-high dome, remarkable gilding, arcades, caryatids and candelabras

verified_facts.text: The five Signature Suites were designed by Pierre-Yves Rochon.
verified_facts.excerpt: The five Signature Suites offer a refined vision of luxury, comfort and Parisian living. Designed by Pierre-Yves Rochon

verified_facts.text: The Signature Suites feature panoramic views over the rooftops of the Opera Garnier or the Eiffel Tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: feature panoramic views over the rooftops of the Opera Garnier or the Eiffel Tower

verified_facts.text: Classic Rooms are decorated in rich colours in the Napoleon III style, with street or courtyard views and marble bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Decorated in rich colours in the Napoleon III style, our Classic Room offer lovely street or courtyard views, marble bathrooms

verified_facts.text: Some rooms feature a private balcony with views over Parisian rooftops.
verified_facts.excerpt: Some Room feature a private balcony with enchanting views over Parisian rooftops

verified_facts.text: Double-glazed windows help guests sleep well.
verified_facts.excerpt: Double-glazed windows ensure you'll get a good night's rest.

verified_facts.text: La Verriere is an 800-square-meter winter garden beneath a glass and metal atrium, for coffee, light dining or an aperitif.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Verrière is a refined 800 sqm winter garden, bathed in natural light beneath an impressive glass and metal atrium. A serene retreat in the heart of Paris, it is ideal for coffee, light dining or an aperitif.

verified_facts.text: Cafe de la Paix, on Place de l'Opera, has been a symbol of Parisian life since 1862 and is led by Chef Laurent Andre, overlooking the Opera Garnier.
verified_facts.excerpt: has been a symbol of Parisian life since 1862. Today, this elegant restaurant led by Chef Laurent André celebrates the great classics of French gastronomy, offering an exceptional dining experience overlooking the Opera Garnier.

verified_facts.text: The original Dry Martini was created at the hotel in 1904 by head bartender Franck Newman.
verified_facts.excerpt: It’s where you can try the original Dry Martini, made with Tanqueray gin and Noilly Prat, which was created here in 1904 by head bartender Franck Newman.

verified_facts.text: The Algotherm Dermo Ocean Spa has the elegant atmosphere of a Parisian apartment, with four single treatment rooms and one double suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa offers a refined wellness experience in the elegant atmosphere of a Parisian apartment. Featuring four single treatment rooms and one double suite

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments use Algotherm, a French skincare brand.
verified_facts.excerpt: exceptional treatments by Algotherm, a renowned French skincare brand

verified_facts.text: The Club Lounge is open daily and serves breakfast, afternoon tea and an evening reception with canapes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open daily, it serves breakfast, afternoon tea and an evening reception with a selection of refined canapés

verified_facts.text: The hotel has been Green Key certified since 2010.
verified_facts.excerpt: Green Key certified since 2010

verified_facts.text: The hotel is close to the Palais Garnier, the Parisian department stores, the Rue de la Paix and its boutiques, and Place Vendome.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Palais Garnier, iconic Parisian department stores, Haussmannian boulevards with their theatres, the Rue de la Paix and its luxury boutiques, and Place Vendôme

verified_facts.text: The department stores Galeries Lafayette and Printemps are a block away.
verified_facts.excerpt: the city’s historic department stores—Galeries Lafayette and Printemps—sit a block away

verified_facts.text: The Palais Royal Gardens and the Louvre are about a 15-minute walk away.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Palais Royal Gardens and the Louvre are an easy 15-minute walk in the other direction

verified_facts.text: Louvre tickets can be bought directly at the concierge desk.
verified_facts.excerpt: Skip the lines by purchasing your tickets directly at the Concierge desk.

verified_facts.text: A portrait of Sarah Bernhardt still graces the reception area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sarah Bernhardt– whose portrait still graces the reception area

verified_facts.text: All rooms feature Byredo amenities, complimentary tea and coffee, and a mini bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: All rooms feature Byredo amenities, complimentary tea and coffee, and a well-stocked mini bar.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, InterContinental Paris - Le Grand does not have a pool.

verified_facts.text: There is a small fitness room with modern machines.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is also a small fitness room with state-of-the-art machines, but no pool.

verified_facts.text: Connecting rooms are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Connecting rooms available
